sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3625 of 2024
Applicant :- Irfan
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Govt. Civil Secrt. Lko.

And
Counsel for Applicant :- Mohd. Waris Farooqui,Shailendra Nath Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
Counter affidavit filed on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that on the basis of the same allegations levelled against co accused Imran has been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 5.4.2024.
Hence the applicant who is languishing in jail since long having no criminal history, may also be enlarged on bail on the ground of parity.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not deny the ground of parity.

sentences.text: 5. Considering and adopting the same reasonings as contained in bail order dated 5.4.2024 passed in the case of co accused coupled with the fact that the applicant is languishing in jail since long having no criminal history, is entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.
6. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Irfan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.0233 of 2023, under Sections 376-D, 323 and 506 I.P.C. and Section 5(J)/II)/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Utraula,
District Balrampur on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.4.2024 Shukla  Irfan vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93462010/
